eligibility.quote: The issue gives a complete reproducer (node source, two XML launch files, build and run commands) with expected "[env_bug_node-1] my_env_var = '2'" and actual "[env_bug_node-1] my_env_var = '4'". A maintainer confirms the cause: "https://github.com/ros2/launch/pull/567 seems to have introduced the behavior change in Foxy."

failed_conditions.quote: `set_env` behaviour seems to have changed. It now "leaks" - `set_env` now affects places that are sequentially before the tag, including overriding those that are set deeper. Now one can only override the last `set_env` with an `env` in `node`/`executable`.

loudness.quote: No diagnostic is shown; the node simply prints the wrong value ("[env_bug_node-1] my_env_var = '4'" where '2' was expected), and the reporter notes it "is also quite difficult to debug" (issue #1244).

resolution.quote: Maintainer: "The change for Foxy has been merged and will be in the upcoming patch release." The issue was then closed; no one reports the reporter's env_bug launch files run against launch 0.10.9 with the expected output.

notes: Adjudicated case C3-034: fully agrees with specification eligibility (E1-E4 step 6), failed conditions, loudness (silent_documented), and resolution status (recommended).
